papilio_dardanus_cenea_specimen.species: Papilio dardanus cenea (African mocker swallowtail female mimetic morph on floral cluster, Maputo, Mozambique)

governing_equations.section: Sekimura et al. (2000) Proc. R. Soc. B 267:851-859 Eqs. (2.1)-(2.4), Table 1 & Figs. 3-6; Madzvamuse et al. (2002) J. Math. Biol. 44:489-509 Eqs. (2.1)-(2.8)
governing_equations.activator_pde: du/dt = gamma * (a - b * u + u^2 / (v * (1 + kappa * u^2))) + div(D_u * grad(u))
governing_equations.anisotropic_diffusivity_tensor: D_u = diag(D_u_par, D_u_perp) = D_u_par * diag(1, epsilon),  D_v = d * D_u,  epsilon = D_perp / D_par
governing_equations.turing_instability_criterion: d * f_u + g_v > 2 * sqrt(d * det(J_0)) = 2 * sqrt(d * b),  d > d_c
governing_equations.melanin_threshold_rule: Melanic black scales form where u(x, y) > u_th; light/coloured mimetic patches form where u(x, y) <= u_th

mimetic_morph_table.pattern_description: Broad continuous proximal-to-median diagonal white patch with black apical margin and submarginal spots
Broad warm brick-red/orange median patch with black costal/apical band and isolated white subapical bar
Predominantly melanic black wing ground broken into discrete buff/cream discal and submarginal spots
Transverse orange/white median band crossing the forewing perpendicular to longitudinal wing veins
